key_insight: PEPRino is a hyperparameter-free, gradient-free optimal control method that uses resummed response functions to generate high-fidelity quantum control pulses.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical route to scalable pulse design for multi-qubit quantum algorithms, reducing tuning effort while improving convergence reliability.
method: Model the control landscape using response theory to infinite nonlinear order.
Evaluate the landscape efficiently by resumming first- and second-order response functions.
Optimize pulses without gradients or hyperparameter tuning, then validate on QFT for 2- and 3-qubit systems.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports benchmark results on 2-qubit QFT against CRAB with Nelder-Mead, showing faster convergence in both iteration count and computational time.
watch_item: Performance is demonstrated only on small QFT instances, so scalability and robustness on larger noisy hardware remain to be established.
paper_title: Pulse engineering via projection of response functions at infinite nonlinear order
